notes: Seven web searches ran, none refused; none returned any AI-related statement by him. Searches on superintelligence, extinction, pause/moratorium and China returned only unrelated results. He has no house.gov site and has held no prior elected office. His campaign site jimforcongress.com (homepage downloaded and its full text checked; jimforcongress.com/issues returns 404) lists priorities on border, cost of living, taxes, budget, regulation, VA hospital, roads, power grid, water, Everglades and offshore drilling, with no mention of AI, technology or data centers. The Business Observer profile (14 Nov 2025) and Sparkers Soapbox general-election guide also have nothing on AI. Ballotpedia page could not be read (empty fetch). No source shows him sponsoring the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act; as a non-member he could not have. Interviews, debates and his radio station broadcasts were not searchable, so absence of evidence is limited to indexed web sources.
